current_content_summary: Abstract type 'a fset represented as the quotient of duplicate-free lists by perm_eq (elems/oflist convert between fset and list, with elemsK/oflistK/fset_eq as the defining axioms). Core API: card, mem/\in/\notin, fset0/fset1, set union/intersection/difference (`|`/`&`/`\`), disjoint, pick, filter, subset (\subset)/proper (\proper), a full battery of algebraic lemmas for the set operators (fsetUC/fsetUA/fsetIC/fsetIA/fsetDUl/etc., mirroring standard set-theory identities), fset_ind (structural induction principle), cardinality lemmas (fcardUI/fcardU/fcardI/fcardD/fcard_eq0/fcard_eq1), image (image f A, the image of a set under a function), product (Cartesian product of two fsets), fold (fset-valued fold), and rangeset m n (the fset {m, m+1, ..., n-1}).
requires: Core, Int, List, StdRing, StdOrder, Finite.
